lessons.title: Tiny EH gains survive recovery; official bake and fixed geometry answer different questions

hardware.model: official CHECK plus H100 local fixed trial

observations.statement: Official CHECK same-job prepare prints about0.13us pooler EH gain.
Official CHECK prepare prints about0.42us QKV hinted EH gain.
Official hinted unpooler EH bake regresses and remains unselected.
Fixed geometry remains mixed, without a minimum tiny-gain filter.

selector.contains: This is three both-estimator-positive EH3 observations, one both-estimator-negative EH2 observation, and four sign disagreements.

hypotheses.statement: EH may offer a small shape/flag-dependent benefit, but sequential bake medians also contain selection and timing context.

lessons.scope: Official CHECK component prepare observations versus a separate four-shape matched local trial; CHECK is not a leaderboard submission.
transfer_limits: Sequential official prepare differences are not balanced causal estimates or whole-score improvements.
Do not substitute EH2 for selected EH3 or transfer a fixed full-width o result to selected HALF/LT.
lessons.falsification: Matched actual-selected EH3 repeats fail to preserve even directional pooler benefit after counterbalanced order and fresh inputs.

next_test.question: Does bounded confirmation retain useful EH choices without forcing EH on mixed shapes?
next_test.discriminator: Confirm close EH3 finalists against their actual selected comparator using balanced fresh-fixture rounds inside a fixed prepare budget; preserve QKV sign disagreement and unselected negative EH alternatives.
next_test.stop_rule: Do not enable universally; decline selection changes if budget or correctness gates fail, without deleting tiny positive observations.

full correctness/ownership/counter/cleanup gates before gain admission
retain all raw signed outcomes; independent validation

lessons.title: A tiny fixed mechanism win can coexist with an unselected path and conflicting package estimators

comparators: fixed mechanism arms separately where declared

sources.role: independently validated immutable actual collection summary

observations.statement: Actual PW38-minus-PW45 paired aggregate point is positive; no effect-size filter.
Actual F1 aggregate point is negative and must remain explicit.
Fixed ST5 HALF fullK tiny paired win over old early ST5 remains preserved.
Fixed ST4 HALF fullK loses the same old control.
Actual PW45 o32 uses GV, so the fixed HALF mechanism is not its serving path.

hypotheses.statement: Independent prepare selections and timing context may explain conflicting package estimators; neither the fixed win nor the package paired point isolates a causal source gain.

lessons.scope: One independently prepared policy per source on local H100; no official result or transfer forecast.
transfer_limits: No official H200 score, independent feature causality, repeat-prepare frequency or saved-time forecast follows.
Retain every signed point and conflicting estimator; source-family retirement is not implied.
lessons.falsification: Evaluate the measured positive package point under root official controls while preserving opposite F1 and exact source/picks. Any mechanism refinement gets a new immutable version and compares actual prepared paths; do not force the fixed winner.
